reason: Primary arXiv HTML, sections 2–5: Mela combines high-/low-frequency test-time memory modules and injects intermediate memory states into a language decoder. Experiments train 400M–1.2B language models on FineWeb-Edu and claim extended effective context beyond fixed pretrained context. Memory occupies about 18–29% of parameters; the paper does not demonstrate reduced inference latency or memory/KV cost and may add memory computation. Plausible sequence-model memory lineage, but efficiency direction is unresolved.
title: Mela: Test-Time Memory Consolidation based on Transformation Hypothesis
